answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 32358 Country: India Title: Can women offer salat in congregation (jamat)? If so then, how? Question: Can women offer salat in congregation (jamat)? If so then, how? Answer ID: 32358 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1061/666/H=1432) Women are asked to perform salah individually in their homes. They are not asked by Shariah to perform slaah with congregation. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
